capabilities: Sync Weread highlights, thoughts, chapter comments and reviews into book notes
Browse a bookshelf with search, folders, category and status filters, and book details
Review cached notes by creation date on a calendar with a year-by-year view
Show weekly, monthly, yearly and total reading time with heatmaps and rankings
Star highlights and arrange them as cards on an Obsidian Canvas
extras: Unofficial plugin; sync is one-way from Weread to Obsidian and regenerates book note bodies, so personal annotations should be kept in separate notes. Some features need a Cookie instead of, or in addition to, an API Key. Requires Obsidian 1.7.2 or newer.
problem: Highlights and thoughts made in Tencent Weread stay inside the app, with no way to keep them as linked Markdown notes in a vault.

relations.evidence: 感谢 wereader、Kindle Plugin、Hypothesis Plugin、Obsidian Plugin Developer Docs

summary: Syncs Tencent Weread highlights, thoughts and reviews into Obsidian book notes, with a bookshelf, reading calendar, statistics and favorites canvas.
